meta.title: Public Expenditure Statistical Analyses 2026
meta.table: Table 5.2 Public sector expenditure on services by sub-function, 2021-22 to 2025-26
meta.basis: TES less spending not funded by the taxes modelled

exclusions.name: Interest on funded public sector pension schemes
exclusions.reason: An accounting entry for the growth of funded schemes' liabilities (chiefly the Local Government Pension Scheme), not a payment from taxes. Employers' contributions, which taxes do pay, are already counted in the services they support.

exclusions.name: Public corporations' debt interest
exclusions.reason: Paid by public corporations out of their own income.

exclusions.name: BBC domestic services
exclusions.reason: Paid for by the television licence fee, which the calculator does not model.

exclusions.name: Council housing investment through Housing Revenue Accounts
exclusions.reason: Capital spending by council housing public corporations, funded by rents and borrowing.

exclusions.name: Investment by transport public corporations (mainly Transport for London)
exclusions.reason: Capital spending by public corporations such as Transport for London's trading arm, funded by fares and borrowing. London Underground is railway spending in PESA.

programmes.title: OSCAR II – publishing data from the database: June 2026
programmes.note: Outlays recorded in HM Treasury's OSCAR II database (provisional), excluding depreciation, provisions, loans and income.

categories.name: Social protection: welfare and pensions
categories.description: Cash benefits: the State Pension and other help for pensioners, Universal Credit, disability and family benefits, and housing support (COFOG 10, less personal social services).

children.name: Old age: State Pension and pensioner benefits
children.description: Mostly the State Pension, plus Pension Credit and the Winter Fuel Payment. Public service pensions are counted net of the contributions paid in.

children.name: Social exclusion: Universal Credit, tax credits and income support
Sickness and disability: incapacity and disability benefits
children.description: Including Personal Independence Payment and Attendance Allowance.

children.name: Family and children: Child Benefit and family support
Social protection n.e.c., including compensation schemes
children.description: Includes compensation paid directly to people, such as for infected blood and the Post Office Horizon scandal.

children.name: Unemployment: Jobseeker's Allowance and related benefits

categories.name: Health
categories.description: The NHS and other health services: hospital and community care, GPs, public health, administration and medical research (COFOG 7).

children.name: Medical services: hospital, GP and community care
Central and other health services: public health and administration

categories.name: Education
categories.description: Early years, schools, further and higher education, and services that support them (COFOG 9).

children.name: Secondary education (including all academies)
children.description: Includes all academies, primary ones too, because the Department for Education records all academy spending as secondary.

children.name: Primary education
children.description: Understated: the Department for Education records all academy spending as secondary.

children.name: Subsidiary services: school meals, transport and other support
Education n.e.c. and not definable by level
Tertiary education (higher education)
children.description: Direct spending such as teaching grants. Student loans are not public spending in this measure.

categories.name: Public sector debt interest
categories.description: Interest on government borrowing and the cost of the Bank of England's bond-buying (COFOG 1.7). Excludes accounting interest on pension schemes and public corporations' own debt.

children.name: Central government debt interest: gilts and Treasury bills
Bank of England Asset Purchase Facility (quantitative easing)
children.description: Losses on the Bank of England's bond-buying, which the Treasury covers in cash under its indemnity.

categories.name: Defence
categories.description: The armed forces, military aid to other countries and defence research (COFOG 2).

categories.name: Personal social services (social care)
categories.description: Social care run by councils for older people, disabled adults and children (the personal social services lines of COFOG 10).

children.name: Family and children: children's social care
Sickness and disability: social care for disabled adults
Old age: social care for older people

categories.name: Public order and safety
categories.description: Police, immigration and border control, fire and rescue, courts and prisons (COFOG 3).

children.name: Immigration and citizenship
children.description: Including asylum support and accommodation, and Border Force.

children.name: Public order and safety n.e.c. and R&D

categories.name: Transport
categories.description: Railways, national and local roads, local public transport and other transport (COFOG 4.5). Excludes investment by public corporations such as Transport for London, funded by fares and borrowing.

children.name: Railway (including London Underground and HS2)
children.description: Excludes investment by public corporations, mainly Transport for London, funded by fares and borrowing.

categories.name: Economic affairs: industry, energy, agriculture and R&D
categories.description: Support for business and employment, energy, agriculture, broadband and research and development (COFOG 4, less transport).

children.name: General economic, commercial and labour affairs
children.description: Business support, trade promotion and employment programmes.

notable.name: UK Research and Innovation
notable.note: A small part of UKRI's spending is classed under health, education and environmental research instead.

categories.name: General public services
categories.description: Parliament, central government, tax collection, diplomacy and net payments to EU institutions (COFOG 1, less debt interest and foreign economic aid).

children.name: Executive and legislative organs, financial and fiscal affairs, external affairs
children.description: Parliament, central government departments, tax collection (HMRC) and diplomacy.

children.name: General services
children.description: Central services such as government property and statistics.

children.name: Basic research and R&D general public services
EU transactions (net)
children.description: Payments to EU institutions less receipts from them. Negative when receipts are larger.

categories.name: Environmental protection
categories.description: Waste management (including nuclear decommissioning), pollution control and nature (COFOG 5).

notable.name: Nuclear Decommissioning Authority (Sellafield and other sites)

children.name: Environmental protection n.e.c. and waste water

categories.name: Housing and community amenities
categories.description: Social housing, community development, street lighting and water supply (COFOG 6). Excludes council housing investment funded by rents through Housing Revenue Accounts.

children.name: Housing development: local authority housing
children.description: Excludes council housing investment funded by rents and borrowing through Housing Revenue Accounts.

children.name: Housing and community amenities n.e.c. and R&D

categories.name: Recreation, culture and religion
categories.description: Museums, libraries, the arts, sport and broadcasting (COFOG 8). Excludes the BBC's licence-fee-funded services.

children.name: Cultural services: museums, libraries and the arts
Recreation, culture and religion n.e.c. and R&D

categories.name: International development (foreign economic aid)
categories.description: Economic aid to other countries (COFOG 1.2). Not the official development assistance (ODA) total, which is measured differently; military aid is under Defence.
